selector: .bbtn,.out button,.opts button,.abs button,.vsug button,.bks button,.mseg button,.rd-sub2 button,.pillb,.pillb2,.wvc,.ex button,.vtry button,.chips button,.sg button,.rd-chips button

decls.transition: width var(--dur-2,220ms) var(--ease-std),background var(--dur-1,150ms) var(--ease-std),color var(--dur-1,150ms) var(--ease-std)

decls.background:
conic-gradient(
    from var(--bot-ang),
    color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,var(--ink)) 8%,var(--line)) 0deg,
    color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,var(--ink)) 32%,transparent) 55deg,
    color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,var(--ink)) 10%,var(--line)) 115deg,
    color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,var(--ink)) 8%,var(--line)) 215deg,
    color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,var(--ink)) 48%,transparent) 290deg,
    color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,var(--ink)) 56%,transparent) 320deg,
    color-mix(in srgb,var(--c,var(--ink)) 8%,var(--line)) 360deg
  )

decls.transition: background-color .4s ease,color .4s ease,border-color .4s ease,box-shadow .4s ease,fill .4s ease,stroke .4s ease
